column5: Module github.com/crewjam/saml is at v0.6.3, which includes the v0.5.2 fix, but the vuln.go.dev record for GO-2026-6909 has no fixed event, so govulncheck still reports it. Mitigation tests that already exist: TestParseResponseRecovered_TurnsLibraryPanicIntoError, TestParseResponse_StrictShape_Refuses, TestParseResponse_StrictShape_RefusesRebindingAndExtraIdentifiers. Re-review at expiry: delete this row once the record has a fixed version at or below the one in go.mod.
